description: This Python source file defines a class for configuring and transforming requests/responses for Volcengine embedding models within a larger machine learning or LLM framework. It includes methods for URL construction, parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, environment validation, and error handling. The class inherits from a base configuration class and references external utility functions and types.
